title: Static ItzRealMe Fire
description: This project adds a static fire texture to prevent high fire from blocking your view during PvP.
body:
# ItzRelame Static Fire

Tired of massive, animated fire textures blocking your screen during PvP fights? This resource pack is designed to solve exactly that problem by providing a clean, performance-friendly alternative.

## 🌟 Features

* **Static Fire:** Completely removes the fire animation to reduce visual clutter and potential lag.
* **Low Fire Design:** The fire height is significantly lowered so you can always keep track of your opponents during combat.
* **PvP Optimized:** Perfect for Crystal PvP or general survival gameplay where visibility matters most.

## 🛠️ Compatibility

This pack is built using flexible format settings. It is fully compatible with Minecraft versions **1.21 all the way up to 1.21.11** without showing any "incompatible" warnings in your resource pack menu.
